svg.title: Quartiles are inverse cumulative-frequency readings and an empty class creates a flat interval
svg.desc: For forty grouped completion times, quartile levels ten, twenty and thirty give estimated quartiles twenty, twenty-eight and thirty-five point five seconds, with interquartile range fifteen point five seconds. Dashed guides run from the count levels to the piecewise-linear graph and down to the time axis. The empty class from ten to below fifteen seconds creates a horizontal segment at cumulative frequency four. Every cutoff from ten through fifteen seconds has that cumulative count, so inverse reading at the ten-percent level gives an interval rather than a unique value. The graph endpoints are class boundaries and need not be observed sample extrema.
